summary: A Palestinian family's home burned after the family reported masked settlers attacked it; police/fire investigators initially attributed the fire to an electrical short circuit, while later remand reporting said police had not produced a final fire-department report and arson had not been ruled out.
discovery_sources: Times of Israel 2026-08-20 and 2026-08-25; WAFA 2026-08-20; Israel National News 2026-08-20
resolution_notes: Fire occurrence is documented, but cause and actor attribution remain materially disputed. Do not canonically label this settler arson unless the forensic/police record resolves the contradiction. The homeowner's later detention/false-complaint charge is not treated as proof that the original account was false; legal status and open-investigation posture are preserved.
media_status: Exact same-event fire video is available via Times of Israel, but it proves the fire/aftermath rather than its cause or perpetrator. No generic imagery.
